procedure.method: Independent fresh critic session with no spawn, fork or resume. Read the exact packet, case, rubric, rules, compact addendum, method and adapter; verified all 35 listed input hashes and byte counts. Read the pinned lamp source manifest and all five pinned native-evidence manifests without following their unlisted embedded paths. The packet has no protected layouts. Actually opened and visually inspected the exact LAMP-FIXTURE PNG using tools.view_image with detail original and emitted its image. Subsequently actually opened and visually inspected all fifteen exact poster PNGs, each using tools.view_image with detail original and emitting the image, in packet order M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4 and M5 in that same view order. Completed the source open and all fifteen poster opens before starting the copy-reading/transcription stage, any judgment or any score. The first readings below were then transcribed manually from the displayed native pixels, with use and thumbnail readability judged from the separately displayed exact reductions. No OCR, substitute asset, image editing, generation, invented tool event or claimed runtime session ID. No ambiguities triggered a revisit. The view receipts attest actual displayed/inspected images, not the hash-verification helper exit. Native dimensions were also checked against PNG headers; all native ratios use the predeclared half-pixel single-edge rounding exception, not exact 16:9 arithmetic.

image_material.location: shade skin, two support collars, oval base and book edge

emotion_control.location: dark left room versus warm book page

ai_slop.location: lamp construction, desk props and right copy field

residuals: The composition is polished but the cozy reading-desk motif and large-left-product/right-information structure recur in the set.

Actual source attachment to every native call is unassessable from the allowed pins; embedded unlisted call-input/pre-call paths were not inspected.

evidence.location: complete lamp and folded illuminated paper montage

The right upper macro shade is an additional crop; it does not replace the required full product. The folded paper and light crease substantively relate to desk-light/paper experience.

evidence.location: upper-right descriptions followed by two information columns

style.checked_requirement:
덕테이프 포스터로 가상 브랜드 온빛의 데스크 램프 체험전을 안내해줘. 첨부 상품 사진을 실제로 참고해 짙은 초록색, 넓고 휘어진 가로 갓, 연결된 두 지지대와 타원형 받침의 특징을 보존하고 각 포스터에서 제품 전체가 한 번은 보여야 해. 표현 방식을 바꿀 수 있고 배경이나 포스터 배치는 보존 조건이 아니야. 실제 출시 정보나 업체 로고는 만들지 말아줘. 제품의 구조와 책상 위의 빛을 경험하는 행사로 느껴지게 해줘. 디지털 홍보용 16:9 가로 포스터를 서로 다른 전체 스타일 다섯 장으로 만들어줘. 본문 설명과 일정·장소·방문 조건·웹주소가 시선의 흐름 안에서 자연스럽게 이어져 읽혀야 해. 제목만 눈에 띄고 본문은 구석에 흩어지거나 작은 글자로 눌리지 않게 해줘. 단색 바탕의 큰 고딕 제목과 정보 블록에 상품 그림을 부가한 템플릿, 글자를 담기 위한 빈 실내 면의 구성은 제외해줘. 아래 문구를 각각 한 번씩 정확히 넣어줘.

Literal client styles:
{"mode": "open", "invocation_interpretation": "Skill invocation is not tape material requirement; product rendering can vary while identity/color remains"}

Literal mandatory client conditions:
Each copy entry once, exact Korean/English words/numbers/punctuation and meaningful word spaces, no added print,logo,QR,watermark or invented specs.
Separate single flat opaque landscape16:9 posters; no mockup or comparison sheet.
Five genuinely distinct whole styles across image/editing/space/type/reading flow, not palette/material substitution of one layout.
Substantive content-grounded nonglyph visual construction; not tiny icon or texture embellishment.
Actually use the supplied synthetic lamp fixture in every native image call. Preserve deep forest-green color, wide horizontally curved shade, two connected supports and oval base; show at least one complete identifiable product each poster. Rendering style/background/scene/layout may vary, no protected poster position or original background.
A commercial lamp experience event, relating visible product structure and desk light to the invitation. Full descriptions,visit details and URL readable in their natural flow at usage720.
Exclude passive solid/near-solid/split-field gothic headline/date/information templates with subordinate images, including small-photo/texture/font-only or empty-room dressing. Gothic type and coherent image-led scenes themselves are permitted. No scoped composition override.

ratio.dimension_source: exact packet native-view metadata; frozen summary independently checks native PNG header

evidence.location: full lamp at left and warm light crease in the folded paper at right
evidence.observation: Product structure and light interacting with paper form major nonglyph elements that contribute directly to the requested lamp experience.

evidence.location: left full lamp and right illuminated folded-paper surface
evidence.observation: The two-support lamp and warm folded-paper illumination remain clearly visible at use size and carry specific desk-light content, not just surface texture or a decorative icon.

content_form.location: lamp, enlarged underside and illuminated paper fold
content_form.observation: The montage connects a complete structural product to its light on paper, giving the invitation to bring paper a visual basis. The picture remains lamp-specific even without the inhabited room used by M1/M4.

hierarchy.location: bottom-left headline versus upper-right prose and small rightmost visit column
hierarchy.observation: The eye finds a large lamp and bottom title first, then must jump diagonally upward for the description before dividing between two much smaller practical-information columns. The visiting invitation/URL receive the weakest emphasis.

typography.location: slanted title/uppercase subtitle and regular right copy
typography.observation: Glyphs and spaces are intact, with deliberate title slant and subtitle tracking.

Visit copy is roughly 10–11 pixels high and tightly packed into a narrow column. The type is readable but the size contrast with the large italic title and hero is excessive for a digital event poster with a full-copy readability requirement.

space.location: right paper field, two small information columns and lower glowing fold
space.observation: The large illuminated fold and surrounding geometric planes occupy substantial area while the admission/invitation/URL column is compact. The right copy is organized, but image area and title scale leave the practical details proportionally underprovided.

image_material.location: metal shade/base and illuminated paper ridge
image_material.observation: Green metal skin, diffuser, attached support collars and oval base have coherent detail. The raised paper fold has readable thickness and warm grazing illumination, and the additional macro shade crop relates to that light.

emotion_control.location: forest-green geometric background and amber paper illumination
emotion_control.observation: The sharper montage still communicates quiet warm desk light with a contemporary graphic energy. The dark/light relationships are controlled and remain related to the product rather than a generic colorful spectacle.

ai_slop.location: complete product structure and repeated shade-detail crop
ai_slop.observation: Both support connections and base are coherent, and no extra label or broken letter is visible. The diagonal crops repeat relevant metal/paper/light materials; the motif is repetitive at set level but locally has a consistent visual relationship.

residuals: The rightmost visit/invitation/URL column is too small relative to the headline and product for strong usage720 typography.
Title at bottom-left, description at upper-right and two differing small detail columns require a discontinuous reading jump.
Large unused paper/fold area could better support the practical copy; angular montage does not by itself resolve the set-wide repeated product-left/information-right organization.
The enlarged shade plus complete left product repeats M1's two-scale product presentation.
Native 1672x941 passes the half-pixel single-edge rounding exception for 16:9. Usage is 720x405 and thumbnail is 320x180; no native or view asset was modified.
Actual reference submission to the native call cannot be verified from the permitted pins.

source_fidelity.observations: The full left lamp preserves the actually viewed fixture identity: deep forest-green curved horizontal shade and rounded end, bright rectangular underside, two cylindrical supports with collars attached to the shade and base, and low oval base. The complete lamp is visible with its shade ends/posts/base inside the frame. An enlarged shade underside is separately cropped at the upper-right, permitted because a full product remains elsewhere. Product is left/lower and relatively large; background, poster-relative position/size and original square-source crop are not protected, and the packet supplies no protected-layout manifest. The geometric montage changes expression without replacing source structure. This is visual fidelity PASS; native-call source-submission provenance is unverified.

recording_adapter.limit: Metadata bindings and attestations do not prove semantic viewing or source fidelity

evidence.location: whole diptych
evidence.observation: M1 uses a straight vertical seam, a complete left lamp/book room scene, left upper title and right macro shade/lit-page information. Its two-scale photographic treatment is related to M5, while the large left lamp/right practical text system recurs in M2 and M3.

evidence.location: whole diagonal light-field illustration
evidence.observation: M2 enlarges the shade across the top and uses carved-print marks, brush/serif type and a rightward light wedge. The title moves right, but the full lamp/books left and description/event/visit block right remain the same basic organization as M1/M3; this is more surface/crop variation than an independent whole system.

evidence.location: whole pale catalog layout
evidence.observation: M3 removes the room/books and uses an outlined pale desk plane, gothic title upper-right and lower divided information. Sparseness changes mood, but the same dominant left lamp/right text map persists; it also introduces the explicitly excluded passive template.

evidence.location: book spread and loose-sheet reading path
evidence.observation: M4 has the strongest structural departure: a foreground book carries title/prose left and event/date on the facing page, with visit copy on a tilted sheet to the right. Nevertheless, the warm green-lamp/wooden-desk/open-book/plant evening scene remains closely related to M1 and M2.

evidence.location: angular montage and lower-left headline
evidence.observation: M5 shifts the title beneath the left full lamp and makes paper/green-material diagonals with an enlarged upper-right shade. It still places descriptions and a small two-column event/visit system on the right illuminated paper, and repeats M1's whole-product/macro-product pairing.

evidence.location: relationship of the five information systems
evidence.observation: M4 genuinely changes the text perspective and page-based flow, while M1 is a diptych and M3 is sparse. These visible changes justify some diversity; they do not establish five fully independent image, space, type and reading-flow systems. M2/M5 also repeat small rightmost visit columns.

residuals: Observed count is exactly five separate flat landscape posters, not a comparison sheet.

Diversity 3 is an independent full-set judgment. Surface/material, crop and title-position variation are real, but most members reuse dominant left complete product with right explanatory/practical copy, repeated green/cream/amber light relationships and desk/book/paper motifs.
M4's foreground page organization is a meaningful departure, retained in the assessment; it does not cancel the repeated organization of the other four.
M3 independently violates the near-solid gothic headline/product-information template exclusion.
M2, M4 and M5 retain usage-size supporting typography below the strong professional execution floor; all low dimensions remain recorded rather than averaged.

The native sizes are 1672x941 for M1/M2/M4/M5 and 1672x940 for M3, all passing only the predeclared 0.5-pixel height-rounding exception for 16:9. Supplied reductions are 720x405 and 320x180 for every member.
